# Massive Integrated Homes (MIH)

> Licensed electrical contractor and smart home integrator based in Greenslopes and Salisbury, Brisbane. We install home automation, lighting, home theatre, TV feature walls, CCTV, EV chargers, Starlink and mesh WiFi across central and south Brisbane and Logan, and also work in north Brisbane. Electrical Contractor Licence No. 1508151. Phone 0480 568 180. 7 days 7am-7pm.
